notes: CREATIVE_BATCH_7.md CB7-S and section 2.8. DRAFT: copy to queue/jobs/ only after the science-reviewer freeze check of the fetcher, the committed rules file and a q0140 PASS. About 9k frame requests (closed and ended-unclosed walks) + 18k print requests (1 per sampled market: /trades?market&start=t7-7d&end=t7-1&takerOnly=true&limit=50) = about 27k requests, about 1.9 h at 4 rps, about 2.4 h wall in 2 chunks of 85 min. Stage order: hash and pin checks, frame walk (streamed, resumable by window), filters (Yes/No labels, life >= 9 d, not weather/TEMP_RE, not CB1_UPDOWN_RE, not geopolitics by fee_category or topic_of, not Other/placeholder), key drop, stratified sample (status x cb1_topic x end month; sports weight 0.25; no price, volume or outcome input), text_features.csv.gz and cut_points.json written and hashed BEFORE any print request, then prints. Outcome prices only in outcomes_guarded.csv.gz. No wallet field is stored. Rows capped at min(T_fetchT, T_seal); no chunk starts at or after T_seal (NOT_RUN_DEADLINE.json, status not_run_deadline). Exit 75 when data-dumps + 0.15 GB > 12.5 GB. Priority 61 with a higher id than q0043/q0081/q0082/q0120, so those T_seal-bound jobs win the net lane at every chunk boundary. Mac fallback: if not started on the host by 2026-10-20T00:00Z, run the identical command on the Mac with --standalone --rps 3 --root ~/arepo_scratch/h8_text (section 2.8), set any host partial run aside unmerged, and cancel this spec. Latest safe start anywhere 2026-10-21T12:00Z. Commit message must record the data-dumps size and margin.
